title: Television
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- TV body -->
  <rect x='18' y='24' width='64' height='48' rx='6' fill='#c8a45c'/>
  <!-- body shading edge -->
  <rect x='18' y='24' width='64' height='48' rx='6' fill='none' stroke='#e8d090' stroke-width='3'/>
  <!-- screen bezel -->
  <rect x='24' y='30' width='44' height='34' rx='3' fill='#5a4a7a'/>
  <!-- screen glass lit -->
  <rect x='27' y='33' width='38' height='28' rx='2' fill='#3fd8e0'/>
  <!-- screen shine -->
  <polygon points='30,36 42,36 33,58 27,58' fill='#a8f4f8' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- screen picture: little mountain scene -->
  <polygon points='31,57 42,42 52,57' fill='#2b8a5a'/>
  <polygon points='45,57 55,45 64,57' fill='#3fa86e'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='39' r='3' fill='#fff3a0'/>
  <!-- control panel -->
  <rect x='70' y='32' width='9' height='30' rx='2' fill='#a8864a'/>
  <!-- knobs -->
  <circle cx='74.5' cy='39' r='3' fill='#e8d090'/>
  <circle cx='74.5' cy='39' r='1.2' fill='#8a6a30'/>
  <circle cx='74.5' cy='49' r='3' fill='#e8d090'/>
  <circle cx='74.5' cy='49' r='1.2' fill='#8a6a30'/>
  <!-- speaker slots -->
  <rect x='71' y='55' width='7' height='1.5' fill='#6a5020'/>
  <rect x='71' y='58' width='7' height='1.5' fill='#6a5020'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='30' y='70' width='5' height='8' rx='2' fill='#8a6a30'/>
  <rect x='65' y='70' width='5' height='8' rx='2' fill='#8a6a30'/>
  <!-- antenna -->
  <line x1='50' y1='24' x2='42' y2='12' stroke='#e8d090' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='41' cy='10' r='3' fill='#ff8a5c'/>
</svg>
